propositions: Add a new 7th link relation called `caused_by` to express causal dependency between tickets, modeled after the `discovered_from` precedent (directional, non-blocking, non-cycle-inducing, Jira-unmapped).
The `caused_by` relation must be added to the hardcoded non-blocking tuple at line ~204 in `src/rebar/graph/_graph.py` or it will incorrectly acquire blocking-cycle semantics.

The relation must be defined in `src/rebar/schemas/common.schema.json` and propagated to `src/rebar/types.py` via code generation, and enumerated across all enforcement and help surfaces (`_links.py`, `unlink.py`, help text, golden CLI snapshots, and MCP writes).
Round-trip tests verify that `rebar link <a> <b> caused_by` persists and retrieves with relation type `caused_by` without treating the edge as a blocker.
Pre-existing LINK events lacking the new relation must continue to reduce without error (backward compatibility).
A `caused_by` cycle (two-node or longer) must be permitted and not raise an error, unlike blocking relations.
